info.title: GrowSurf REST API
info.description:
Public GrowSurf REST API for managing programs, participants, referrals,
rewards, affiliate commissions, payouts, and analytics.

Every endpoint except `POST /accounts` requires a GrowSurf REST API key in the
`Authorization: Bearer <api_key>` header. You can create multiple API keys in the GrowSurf
dashboard, with optional scopes and program access limits.

Each operation lists its required API-key scope in `x-growsurf-required-scopes`.
Team scopes cover team details and verification; program scopes cover program settings,
reward configuration, and webhooks; participant scopes cover participant records and
referrals; reward scopes cover sales, commissions, payouts, and issued rewards; and
analytics scope covers aggregate reporting. `api_key:rotate` is available only to direct
API-key REST/SDK clients and is unavailable through MCP. `reward:fulfill` is separate
because fulfillment may deliver something of value.

The team owner's email address must be verified before the API can manage programs and their
resources. Until it is, those endpoints return a `403` with error code
`EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED_ERROR`. Resend the owner verification email via
`POST /team/owner/verification-email`, then retry.

For agent-led onboarding, use the canonical Arazzo 1.1 workflow at
`https://growsurf.com/arazzo.yaml`. It creates an account, stops for owner email verification,
and resumes with draft program configuration. It never launches a program or performs a paid,
reward, payout, key-rotation, or destructive action.

REST responses include `RateLimit-Policy` and `RateLimit` fields so clients can throttle before
they reach a quota. Before authentication, these fields describe only the caller's public
network budget. After authentication, they describe the credential and team budgets. A `429`
response also includes `Retry-After`; that value takes precedence when it is present. GrowSurf's
legacy rate-limit fields remain available for backward compatibility.

GrowSurf versions this API in the URL and gives at least 12 calendar months of public notice
before a planned breaking removal. The notice period starts when the public OpenAPI schema marks
the affected surface as deprecated and GrowSurf publishes migration guidance. Urgent security,
privacy, legal, or service-integrity requirements can require a shorter window. See the public
lifecycle policy for the full rules and machine-readable signals.

Every REST response carries `Link: <policy-url>; rel="deprecation"` (RFC 9745), which points at
that lifecycle policy. A surface that is actually deprecated adds a `Deprecation` field, and one
with a planned shutdown date adds a `Sunset` field (RFC 8594). No `Deprecation` field means the
surface is not deprecated.

signals: Deprecation response field (RFC 9745) once a surface is deprecated
Sunset response field (RFC 8594) once a shutdown date is planned
deprecated: true in this OpenAPI document

get.description: Retrieves the team bound to the API key or OAuth connection. `verificationStatus` is `VERIFIED` once GrowSurf has verified the team, which is required before a program can send participant emails.

patch.description: Updates the name of the team bound to the API key or OAuth connection. Any other property is rejected with a `400`. Personal profiles, billing, and team ownership are not editable here.

post.summary: Create an account without an API key
post.description: Creates a new GrowSurf account. This is the only endpoint that does not require an API key. Before calling it, an authorized account owner must review and approve GrowSurf's [Terms of Service](https://growsurf.com/terms) and [Privacy Policy](https://growsurf.com/privacy). The account starts a 14-day Business trial without a credit card. The response includes an API key for the new account, shown once in the response. The key is a secret: store it in a secret manager and do not put it in logs, screenshots, URLs, model context, analytics, or generated output. A lost key cannot be recovered through this API, so do not create an account here unless you can store the key somewhere that outlives the current conversation. If you cannot, ask the account owner to connect GrowSurf's hosted MCP server at `https://mcp.growsurf.com` instead, which keeps the credential with your tool rather than in chat. The key is locked until the team owner's email address is verified: authenticated program and resource endpoints return a `403` with error code `EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED_ERROR` until then (resend the email via `POST /team/owner/verification-email`, then retry). Verification unlocks this same key — keep it and retry rather than requesting a replacement. A welcome email is sent to the address with the verification link and a set-password link for dashboard access. Accounts whose email is never verified are deleted automatically after 7 days. Separately, for security, the API key is replaced the first time the account owner signs in to the GrowSurf dashboard; email verification does not trigger that, and the previous key then returns a `403` with error code `NOT_AUTHORIZED_ERROR`. Some actions (such as emailing participants) additionally require GrowSurf to verify the team first. Calling this endpoint accepts those policies on the account holder's behalf.

409.description: The account could not be created with the supplied details.

example.name: AccountCreationConflictError
example.message: The account could not be created with the supplied details. To continue with an account you set up earlier, sign in at https://app.growsurf.com, then connect your AI assistant in Settings > AI Connections at https://app.growsurf.com/settings#ai-connections.

post.description: Requests GrowSurf to verify the bound team (required before a program can email its participants). Idempotent — calling it again while a request is pending does not create a duplicate. Returns the team with its updated `verificationStatus`.

Resends the email-verification message to the owner of the account the API key belongs to. This is the recovery path for a `403` with error code `EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED_ERROR`, so it stays callable with any GrowSurf API key while the rest of the API is locked. The response never reveals the owner's email address. A `200` with `status: SENT` is returned only when an email was actually dispatched. Returns `400` if the email is already verified, and `429` if a verification email was sent too recently — wait a moment, then retry.

Generates a new API key and makes the key used on this request stop working when rotation succeeds. Send a unique, random `Idempotency-Key`. If the response is interrupted, immediately retry with the original API key and the same `Idempotency-Key` to receive the same new key. Update every integration that used the old key. The team owner is notified by email whenever the key is rotated. GrowSurf SDKs generate the idempotency key automatically. This endpoint accepts an API key with `api_key:rotate`. If this scope is unavailable, rotate the key in the authenticated dashboard instead. This operation is available only through the REST API or a GrowSurf API SDK, not through MCP.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique, random value for this rotation request. Reuse this value only when retrying the same request with the original API key.

get.description: Retrieves a list of your programs. Deleted programs are not returned.

post.description: Creates a new program, plus any optional campaign rewards. The new program is created in `DRAFT` status and owned by the API key's bound team.

402.description: This action isn't available for your account yet (it needs an active subscription or a payment method on file), or the program limit was reached.

get.description: Retrieves a program for the given program ID.

patch.description: Updates a program's identity and lifecycle. Only the fields you send are changed. `type`, `urlId`, and `currencyISO` are immutable. Editor-tab configuration (design, emails, options, installation) is edited via the dedicated config sub-resources, not here. The program cannot be deleted via this endpoint.

post.description: Clones an existing program into a new `DRAFT` program. Integrations and credentials are not copied; active rewards are cloned.

get.description: Retrieves analytics for a program. Pass `interval` to also get a time-series (`series`) alongside the totals, and `include` to add previous-period totals, status breakdowns, derived rates, email performance, or participant engagement. Add `email` to `include` for `sent` (accepted for delivery), `delivered`, `opened`, `clicked`, `bounced`, and `spamComplaints` metrics plus per-email-type breakdowns. Add `engagement` for unique active, sharing, repeat, and retained participants plus portal-view and share-action totals. Email rates and engagement comparisons are ratios from `0` to `1`. Email `isPartial` and engagement coverage states distinguish unavailable or partial data from measured zeroes.

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: When set to `day`, `week`, or `month`, the response also includes a `series` array with per-period totals and uses the same bucket size for `engagement.series`. Defaults to `total` (no legacy series); `engagement.series` uses daily buckets when `interval` is `total` or omitted.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of optional data to include: `previousPeriod` adds totals for the equal-length window immediately before the requested one; `statusCounts` adds reward (and, for affiliate programs, affiliate/commission/payout) status breakdowns; `rates` adds derived referral rates; `email` adds `sent`, `delivered`, `opened`, `clicked`, `bounced`, `spamComplaints`, and per-email-type metrics; `engagement` adds unique participant engagement, action totals, comparisons, and platform/source/channel breakdowns. When `email` and an interval are both requested, each `series` item also contains counts for emails sent during that period. Combine `email` with `previousPeriod` to include the same email metrics in both windows.

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: IANA timezone used for engagement interval boundaries and distinct-day calculations. Used only when `include` contains `engagement`.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Limits engagement events to one client platform. Used only when `include` contains `engagement`.

get.description: Retrieves activation for eligible participants in one exact half-open enrollment cohort. `aggregate` covers the complete selected cohort, while `cohorts` splits that same range by `cohortInterval`. Each participant has the selected `observationWindowDays` after their eligibility date to reach each ordered stage. If `cohortFrom` and `cohortTo` are omitted, GrowSurf selects the latest fully matured rolling cohort. Unavailable and partial states preserve unknown pre-coverage data instead of reporting false zeroes. One request can return at most 100 cohort buckets.

parameters.name: cohortFrom
parameters.description: Inclusive cohort start as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds. Provide it together with `cohortTo`, or omit both for the latest fully matured cohort.

parameters.name: cohortTo
parameters.description: Exclusive cohort end as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds. Provide it together with `cohortFrom`, or omit both for the latest fully matured cohort.

parameters.name: cohortInterval
parameters.description: Bucket size for the `cohorts` array.

parameters.name: observationWindowDays
parameters.description: Days after each participant's eligibility date in which stages can count.

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: IANA timezone used to advance cohort bucket boundaries.

get.description: Retrieves the program's configured Campaign Rewards, including rewards with `isVisible: false` and rewards whose group is not selected. Deleted rewards are excluded. Use this list to review and update switched-off starter rewards. `isVisible: true` alone does not mean a reward can be earned: a reward whose group is not selected can still be visible. A reward can be earned only when it also appears in the campaign response's embedded `rewards` array, which includes only enabled, visible rewards. Delete a reward with `DELETE /campaign/{id}/reward-configs/{campaignRewardId}`.

post.description:
Creates a new campaign reward (`CampaignReward`) with a GrowSurf-assigned ID. The reward type must be compatible with the program type (affiliate programs support only `AFFILIATE` rewards; referral programs support all other types). Enabling an active reward of a type automatically enables that reward type on the program.
For a referral reward, `event: LEAD` earns the reward on a referred signup and requires the program's `referralTrigger` to be `CUSTOM`; `event: CONVERSION` earns it on the later qualifying action. For an affiliate reward, `commissionStructure.event: LEAD` requires a `FIXED` commission with a positive `amount`; `SALE` can use `FIXED` or `PERCENT`.

value.description: Refer a friend and get a Pied Piper T-Shirt
value.referralDescription: Join and receive the middle-out compression algorithm

patch.description:
Updates an existing campaign reward (`CampaignReward`). The reward `type` is immutable and cannot be changed. When the update replaces `metadata`, renamed keys automatically rewrite any `{{campaignReward[…]}}` references in campaign copy; removing a key that campaign copy still references returns a `409` listing the referencing fields.
For a referral reward, `event: LEAD` earns the reward on a referred signup and requires the program's `referralTrigger` to be `CUSTOM`; `event: CONVERSION` earns it on the later qualifying action. For an affiliate reward, `commissionStructure.event: LEAD` requires a `FIXED` commission with a positive `amount`; `SALE` can use `FIXED` or `PERCENT`.

value.description: Refer a friend and get a Pied Piper hoodie

delete.description: Deletes a campaign reward (`CampaignReward`). The reward is deactivated, removed from the program's reward set, and any connected upfront-discount coupons are cleaned up. If campaign copy still references any of the reward's metadata keys via `{{campaignReward[…]}}` tokens, the delete returns a `409` listing the referencing fields — update those fields first.

get.description: Returns all draft and published FILE, LINK, and TEXT resources in their participant display order. Private file delivery coordinates are never returned.

post.description: Creates one resource at the end of the program's order. LINK URLs must use HTTPS. TEXT content is plain text. To create a new FILE, first request an upload ticket, upload the bytes directly to the returned URL, then send the upload result as `uploadResult` with the one-time `uploadTicket`. A FILE is available to participants while its security review is pending; a rejected review blocks it.

patch.description: Updates the supplied content or publication fields. Set `position` to move the resource; GrowSurf compacts the remaining positions. Changing `type` requires the complete fields for the new type. A FILE whose security review rejected it cannot be published or downloaded; a pending review does not block it.

delete.description: Deletes the program resource and compacts the remaining order. A referenced Media Center file is not deleted.

post.summary: Create a program resource upload ticket
post.description: Creates a short-lived, one-time ticket and signed fields for an access-controlled FILE upload. The ticket is bound to this team, program, file name, MIME type, and byte size. Upload the exact bytes to `uploadUrl` with `uploadParameters`, then create or update a FILE resource with the returned upload result. This operation returns `503` until secure file review is configured.

get.description: Retrieves a program's email configuration — the same surface as the dashboard Program Editor's **Emails** tab. Returns each editable email template (`subject`, `preheader`, `body`, `isEnabled`) plus the `settings` block (sender, contact, and design). The set of email templates returned depends on the program type (referral vs affiliate).

patch.description: Updates a program's email configuration. Only the fields you send are changed; omitted fields are left untouched. You may only write the email templates the dashboard exposes for the program type — writing a template that is not available for the program type returns a `400`. Some fields are read-only (`settings.sender.fromEmail`, whose custom value requires dashboard domain verification).

get.description: Retrieves a program's installation configuration — the same surface as the dashboard Program Editor's **Installation** tab (plus the Mobile SDK settings). Includes the referral trigger (referral programs only), signup tracking method, share URL and whitelist, custom-form signup settings, and mobile SDK settings.

patch.description: Updates a program's installation configuration. Only the fields you send are changed; omitted fields are left untouched. `referralTrigger` is only available for referral programs. `mobile.publicKey` is read-only; if no key exists yet, enabling `mobile.isEnabled` creates one. Changing `shareUrl` re-resolves its redirect destinations, which may take a moment to complete. URLs must include an explicit `http://` or `https://` scheme.

post.description: Renders the program's current saved configuration into two preview images: the referrer window a participant sees, and the referred-friend experience. Use them to show a person what the draft looks like before anything launches. The images render GrowSurf's own preview, not the program's installed website, so they do not prove an installation. Show each image inline when the client supports it, and include an Open preview link using the exact returned URL. Some clients cannot display remote images inline. Each URL is private and expires at `expiresAt`; compare that timestamp with the current UTC time before reporting it expired. Capture again after expiry. Only the account owner's credential can capture screenshots, and the endpoint takes no request body.

200.description: Two preview images with expiring URLs.

get.description: Retrieves a program's options — the same surface as the dashboard Program Editor's **Options** tab. Includes the attribution model, reward/fraud approval, anti-fraud lists + toggles, referral cookie/credit windows, reCAPTCHA, affiliate enrollment + application review, payout threshold + tax settings (affiliate only), and notification-email settings. `fraud.recaptcha.secretKey` is never returned.

patch.description: Updates a program's options. Only the fields you send are changed. Some fields are program-type specific (`requireManualRewardApproval`/`autoFulfillRewards` are referral-only; `affiliateApplicationMode`/`affiliateReapplicationPolicy` and `payoutThreshold`/`taxDocumentation` are affiliate-only, and affiliate programs require `requireParticipantAuth: true`). `fraud.recaptcha.secretKey` is write-only. `referralCreditWindowDays: null` means "never expires".

get.description: Retrieves a program's configured design fields: the dashboard Program Editor's **Design** tab plus the payout-destination confirmation page copy configured from payout integration cards. This includes the GrowSurf window layout, header, share channels and invites, signup form, portal and landing pages, theme styling, and referral or affiliate summary and status sections. The available fields depend on the program type. `payoutDestinationConfirmation` is omitted when no confirmation fields are stored. Stored `null` fields are returned as `null`; omitted and `null` fields use localized defaults.

patch.description: Updates a program's design configuration, including the payout-destination confirmation page copy configured from payout integration cards. Only the fields you send are changed; anything you leave out is untouched (arrays such as `signup.fields` replace wholesale). Unknown fields, fields not available for the program type, and invalid values return a `400`. Landing-page custom code and JavaScript are not editable via the API.

get.description:
Retrieves a paged list of participants in a program.

Pass `metadata[key]=value` to return only participants whose stored metadata matches every given key and value exactly, for example `metadata[customerId]=12345`. Up to 3 keys per request. Filtered results are ordered by participant `id` and page with the same `nextId` and `limit` parameters. Filtered requests are rate limited separately from unfiltered ones and return `429` when that limit is reached.
Retrieves participants in leaderboard order for the specified leaderboard type.

parameters.name: isMonthly
parameters.description: Deprecated. Use `leaderboardType=CURRENT_MONTH` instead.

parameters.name: leaderboardType
parameters.description: Leaderboard ordering mode.

post.description: Adds a new participant to the program. If the email already exists, the existing participant is returned unchanged. For affiliate programs, set `isAffiliate` to `true` to enroll a new participant as an approved affiliate or `false` to create a non-affiliate. If you omit `isAffiliate`, a valid `referredBy` creates a referred non-affiliate; without a valid referrer, the new participant is enrolled as an approved affiliate. You can send a valid `referredBy` with `isAffiliate: true` to keep the referral attribution and enroll the participant as an affiliate. A new participant with a valid `referredBy` counts as a referred signup. When the program's `referralTrigger` is `CUSTOM`, that signup can earn Lead-event rewards and commissions for the referrer, the same as a signup through the public client or mobile flow.

422.description: Participant was blocked or the endpoint is not available for this program type.

get.description: Retrieves a single participant by GrowSurf participant ID or email address.

post.description: Updates a participant by GrowSurf participant ID or email address. For affiliate programs, set `affiliateStatus` to `APPROVED`, `SUSPENDED`, or `BANNED`. `APPROVED` enrolls the participant as an affiliate. `SUSPENDED` and `BANNED` require an existing affiliate. This endpoint does not accept `isAffiliate`, and affiliate enrollment cannot be removed through REST. Setting `referredBy` on a participant without a referrer counts as a referred signup: when the program's `referralTrigger` is `CUSTOM` and the referral is `CREDIT_PENDING`, it can earn Lead-event rewards and commissions for the referrer once. A referrer assigned with `referralStatus: CREDIT_AWARDED` does not earn Lead value.

delete.description: Removes a participant by GrowSurf participant ID or email address. A `202` response means participant cleanup completed and analytics erasure is pending. Analytics reports can retain the removed participant until erasure completes. Do not repeat the deletion to finish analytics erasure; GrowSurf processes it automatically.

202.description: Participant cleanup completed; analytics erasure is pending.

analyticsErasure.description: Analytics erasure accepted for automatic processing.

post.description: Deletes a list of participants from a program in one request. Each entry in `participants` is a GrowSurf participant ID or an email address (mixed lists are allowed). Up to `200` entries per request — chunk larger lists across multiple calls. The response reports a per-row `status` for every submitted entry, so a `200` can include rows that were `NOT_FOUND` or failed. Deletion is permanent and removes the participants' referrals, rewards, commissions, and payout records. A `202` response also includes `analyticsErasure` when analytics erasure is pending. A `DELETED` row means participant cleanup completed; analytics reports can retain that participant until erasure completes. Do not repeat successful rows to finish analytics erasure.

200.description: Per-row outcomes returned (individual rows may still be `NOT_FOUND`, `DUPLICATE`, or `ERROR`).

202.description: Per-row outcomes returned; analytics erasure is pending. Individual rows may still be `NOT_FOUND`, `DUPLICATE`, or `ERROR`.

analyticsErasure.description: Analytics erasure accepted for automatic processing.

get.description: Lists every integration this program can connect, each with its current state. Integrations that do not apply to the program type are omitted (for example, Wise on a referral program). Read-only: connecting an integration is an OAuth or credential handshake completed in the GrowSurf dashboard, so it cannot be done over the API. `connected` means credentials are stored, `enabled` means the integration is switched on and working, and `autoDisabled` means GrowSurf switched it off after repeated delivery failures — its credentials are still stored, but it delivers nothing until it is reconnected in the dashboard. `connectUrl` is the dashboard link to hand the person running the program when they want to connect one.
Lists a program's webhooks (secrets are never returned).

post.description: Adds a webhook to the program.
Sends a live test event to a webhook using its stored URL and secret.

get.description: Lists an affiliate program's applications, newest first. Applications exist on programs that review public signups (an `affiliateApplicationMode` of `MANUAL_REVIEW` or `AUTO_APPROVE`). A pending applicant is not a participant until their application is approved.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only return applications with this status.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many applications to return per page (1-100).

get.description: Returns one affiliate application, including its submitted form answers.

patch.description: Decides a pending application. Set `status` to `APPROVED` to enroll the applicant (this creates the participant, or upgrades an existing participant with the same email), or to `DENIED` with an optional `rejectionReason`. A denied applicant may reapply after the program's reapplication cooldown; send an earlier `reapplyAllowedAt` (without `status`) to shorten that wait for one applicant. Approval is idempotent: repeating it returns the same participant.

409.description: The application was already decided (approve/deny can only run once), or `reapplyAllowedAt` was sent for an application that is not denied.

get.description: Lists an affiliate program's enrollment invites, newest first.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only return invites with this status.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many invites to return per page (1-100).

post.description: Invites someone to join the affiliate program. GrowSurf emails them a single-use accept link; accepting it enrolls them as an approved affiliate without going through the public application. One active invite can exist per email address.

409.description: An active invite already exists for this email, or the email already belongs to an affiliate.

delete.description: Revokes a pending invite. Its emailed accept link stops working immediately.

409.description: Only a pending invite can be revoked.

post.description: Re-sends a pending invite with a fresh accept link (the previous link stops working). Resends are rate limited per invite; retry after a few minutes if a resend was just sent.

409.description: The invite is not pending, or its resend cooldown has not elapsed yet.

get.description: Returns a participant's activity logs, most recent first (offset/limit paginated).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of logs to return (1–100, default 20).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of logs to skip.

get.description: Retrieves analytics for a single participant — all-time engagement counters, leaderboard ranks, and per-channel share counts (plus affiliate revenue, commission, and payout metrics for affiliate programs). Pass `include=email` for `sent` (accepted for delivery), `delivered`, `opened`, `clicked`, `bounced`, and `spamComplaints` metrics attributed to this participant, including invitations they sent. Use `include=email,series` to include the same counts in each UTC series bucket. Pass `include=activation` for covered participant enrollment, cohort anchor, and first milestones. Request both `activation` and `series` to add covered `portalViews` and `shareActions` to each series bucket. `days`, `startDate`, and `endDate` filter only the optional `series` and `email` data. They do not filter the top-level `analytics`, `ranks`, `shareCount`, or `activation` values.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Comma-separated optional data. `series` returns this participant's own activity per period; `email` returns `sent`, `delivered`, `opened`, `clicked`, `bounced`, `spamComplaints`, and per-email-type metrics attributed to the participant for the requested analytics window (including invitations they sent). Request both in either order to add email counts to every series item for emails sent during that period. `activation` returns covered enrollment, cohort-anchor, and first-milestone values. Request `activation,series` to add `portalViews` and `shareActions`; those values are `null` outside known coverage. Only documented tokens are accepted; an unknown token returns `400`.

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: Bucket size for the `series` (only used when `include` contains `series`). Defaults to `day`.

post.description: Sends an email to a participant. Provide EITHER `emailType` to trigger one of the program's configured email templates, OR `subject` + `body` for a free-form email. Free-form emails are sent with the same compliance handling (company name, postal address, and an unsubscribe link are added automatically, and unsubscribed participants are suppressed). Sending requires the team to be verified by GrowSurf. Requires a **verified custom email domain** on the program (which can be completed in *Campaign Editor > 3. Emails > Email Settings*). Returns `400` until one is verified. The email is accepted for delivery. `welcomeNonReferred` can only be sent to advocates or approved, enrolled affiliates in a program that has not ended. Returns `400` for other recipients.

Triggers referral credit for an existing referred participant by GrowSurf participant ID or email address. Optionally pass `delayInDays` to hold the credit for a number of days before it is awarded (for example, to cover your own refund window). A delayed trigger can be cancelled before it is awarded with the Cancel delayed referral trigger request (DELETE on this same path).

delayed.summary: Hold credit for a 14-day refund window, then award

value.message: Referral credit is scheduled to be awarded in 14 days.
Referral credit has already been awarded

delete.description: Cancels a pending delayed referral trigger for a participant (the companion to a delayed Trigger referral request). Use this to undo a scheduled referral credit before it is awarded, for example when a refund occurs inside your refund window. If the participant has no pending delayed trigger, `success` is returned as `false`.

200.description: Delayed referral trigger cancellation result returned.

value.message: Successfully cancelled the delayed referral trigger.
There is no delayed referral trigger to cancel for this participant.

post.description: Creates or returns a participant using the same input behavior as Add Participant, then returns a participant-scoped token for GrowSurf mobile SDK participant endpoints. Use this endpoint from your backend after your mobile app authenticates a signed-in user. The program must have mobile SDK access enabled.

200.description: Participant and mobile participant token returned.

422.description: Participant was blocked or the endpoint is not available for this program type.

post.description: **Affiliate programs only.** Records a sale made by a referred customer and generates affiliate commissions for their referrer when applicable. Requires at least one transaction identifier (externalId, transactionId, orderId, paymentId, invoiceId, paymentIntentId, or chargeId) so repeated requests can be de-duplicated — without one, a resent sale would create a second commission. Reuse the same identifier(s) when refunding.

value.message: Sale was successfully recorded. Commission(s) for the referrer will be generated, if applicable.
Sale already recorded for identifiers: invoiceId. Matching commission IDs: jy6kl1

post.description: **Affiliate programs only.** Records an amendment (refund, partial refund, refund cancellation, or chargeback) against a previously recorded transaction and reverses or adjusts the referrer's commission. The inverse of Record Affiliate Transaction. Identify the original transaction with the same identifier(s) you sent when recording it. Commissions already paid out to the affiliate are not clawed back. The amendment still updates the sale revenue used in program reporting; full refunds and chargebacks also update tax reporting.

value.message: No matching commission was found for the provided identifiers. Nothing was amended.

409.description: The refund amendment has missing or conflicting per-refund history. Record each original refund with its stable `refundId` and positive `refundAmount`. After reconciling all original refunds, set `refundHistoryComplete` to `true` to resolve incomplete history. The cancellation is not applied on conflict. Newly observed higher cumulative refunds and incomplete coverage are retained for reconciliation.

get.description: Retrieves a paged list of rewards earned by a participant.

post.description: Approves a manually approved reward earned by a participant. This requires `reward:write`. When the request also sets `fulfill` to `true`, it additionally requires `reward:fulfill`.
Marks an approved participant reward as sent. This status does not confirm delivery.

delete.description: Removes a manually approved participant reward that has not already been approved.

get.description: Retrieves a list of all referrals and email invites made by participants in a program.
Retrieves referrals and email invites made by a participant.

goal.description:
What the program is for, which seeds the share buttons and the starter rewards that suit that audience. Set it when you create the program; it is not accepted on update.

Programs whose participants refer other businesses (`CUSTOMERS`, `USERS`, `B2B_SAAS_SELF_SERVICE`, `B2B_SAAS_ENTERPRISE`, `HEALTHCARE_PROVIDERS`) start with the LinkedIn share button visible. Consumer, financial, education, insurance, telehealth, newsletter, and waitlist programs (`B2C_SUBSCRIPTIONS`, `FINANCIAL_SERVICES`, `ONLINE_EDUCATION`, `INSURANCE`, `ONLINE_INSURANCE`, `TELEHEALTH`, `SUBSCRIBERS`, `WAITLIST`) start with it hidden. On a referral program, each goal also sets the rest of its share buttons to suit that audience — a telehealth program keeps the public feeds off, a consumer subscription turns Pinterest and Reddit on. An affiliate program has its own share defaults, so only the LinkedIn default above applies to one. Omit `goal` and every share button keeps its standard default. Change any of it afterward with `PATCH /campaign/{id}/design`.

When you create a referral program without `rewards`, the goal also decides the starter rewards: most goals get one double-sided reward, `HEALTHCARE_PROVIDERS` gets a single-sided reward, `SUBSCRIBERS` gets a four-step milestone ladder, and `WAITLIST` gets a leaderboard. Every starter reward arrives switched off with a placeholder name, so the program awards nothing until you set the amount and turn one on.

`TELEHEALTH` is for consumer telehealth and wellness subscriptions, where patients refer friends. `HEALTHCARE_PROVIDERS` is for provider networks and clinician-facing products, where practices refer peer practices. `INSURANCE` replaces `ONLINE_INSURANCE`, which is still accepted and behaves identically.

invite.description: The invitation email a participant sends to friends. Its `useCompanyReplyTo` field sets whether replies go to your company or to the participant who sent the invite. Available for both referral and affiliate programs.

loginLink.description: The one-time sign-in link emailed to returning participants. Applies when participant sign-in is required (in Options). Labeled "One-Time Login Link" in the Program Editor. This is a transactional email, so its on/off toggle cannot be changed. Available for both referral and affiliate programs.

payoutDestinationConfirmation.description: Asks a participant to confirm the payout destination where they will receive payouts (for example a PayPal or Wise email address). The body may use `{{payoutProvider}}` for the provider name and must keep the `{{payoutDestinationConfirmationLink}}` confirmation link. This is a transactional email, so its on/off toggle cannot be changed. Available for both referral and affiliate programs.

payoutDestinationChanged.description: Tells a participant that their payout destination changed. The body must keep `{{payoutDestinationMaskedEmail}}` so the notice identifies the new destination without showing the full address. This is a transactional email, so its on/off toggle cannot be changed. Available for both referral and affiliate programs.

taxInfoMissing.description: Asks a participant to submit the tax information required before they can be paid. Sends only when the program collects tax information. Its on/off toggle cannot be changed. Available for both referral and affiliate programs.

taxInfoReceived.description: Confirms to a participant that the tax information they submitted was received. Its on/off toggle cannot be changed. Available for both referral and affiliate programs.

taxInfoApproved.description: Tells a participant that their tax form is complete and approved. Labeled "Tax Form Complete" in the Program Editor. Its on/off toggle cannot be changed. Available for both referral and affiliate programs.

taxInfoRejected.description: Tells a participant that their tax information was rejected and needs to be resubmitted. Its on/off toggle cannot be changed. Available for both referral and affiliate programs.

affiliateApplicationReceived.description: Confirms to an applicant that their affiliate application was received and is under review. Sends when the program reviews public signups (an `affiliateApplicationMode` of `MANUAL_REVIEW` or `AUTO_APPROVE`). This is a transactional email, so its on/off toggle cannot be changed. Affiliate programs only.

affiliateApplicationApproved.description: Tells an applicant that their affiliate application was approved and welcomes them into the program. This is a transactional email, so its on/off toggle cannot be changed. Affiliate programs only.

affiliateApplicationDenied.description: Tells an applicant that their affiliate application was not approved. This is a transactional email, so its on/off toggle cannot be changed. Affiliate programs only.

inviteAffiliate.description: Invites a prospective affiliate to join the program. The body must keep `{{affiliateInviteLink}}`. This is a promotional email, so its on/off toggle can be changed. Affiliate programs only.

affiliateApplicationStatusLink.description: Sends an applicant a secure link to view their affiliate application status. Applies when `affiliateApplicationMode` is `MANUAL_REVIEW` or `AUTO_APPROVE`. The body must keep `{{applicationStatusLink}}`. This is a transactional email, so its on/off toggle cannot be changed. Affiliate programs only.

affiliateApplicationEmailCorrection.description: Asks an applicant to confirm a corrected email address before their affiliate application is updated. The body must contain `{{identityVerificationLink}}`. This is a transactional email, so its on/off toggle cannot be changed. Affiliate programs only.

affiliateEmailChangeVerification.description: Asks an affiliate to confirm a new account email address before it is updated. The body must contain `{{identityVerificationLink}}`. This is a transactional email, so its on/off toggle cannot be changed. Affiliate programs only.

settings.description: Sender, contact, and design settings for the program's emails (the Emails > Settings sub-page).

isCustomForm.description: Whether signups come from your own form instead of automatic form detection.

redirectAfterSignup.description: Whether the signup form redirects to another page after submission.

redirectUrl.description: URL the signup form redirects to. Must include an `http(s)://` scheme. Send `null` to clear.

trackInputFields.description: Whether GrowSurf watches signup form fields for referral attribution.

CampaignInstallationMobile.description: Settings for the GrowSurf iOS and Android mobile SDKs — enable the mobile SDK, the read-only publishable key, and the iOS/Android attribution and app-store URLs used to route mobile referral-link clicks.

isEnabled.description: Whether the mobile SDK is enabled for the campaign.

publicKey.description: The publishable mobile SDK key used by the GrowSurf iOS and Android SDKs. Read-only.

iosAttributionUrl.description: iOS attribution URL. Must include an `http(s)://` scheme; no `#!` or `??`. Send `null` to clear.

iosAppStoreUrl.description: iOS App Store URL used for mobile referral links.

androidAppStoreUrl.description: Google Play Store URL used for mobile referral links.

CampaignInstallation.description: A program's installation configuration (the dashboard Program Editor's Installation tab). To see the full object with every field and its current value, `GET` this resource, then `PATCH` back only the fields you want to change. `referralTrigger` is only present and writable for referral programs.

referralTrigger.description: Referral programs only. Sets what a referred friend must do before a referral counts. `ON_SIGNUP` ("Sign Up") counts the referral as soon as they sign up. `CUSTOM` ("Sign Up + Qualifying Action") counts it only after they sign up and also complete a qualifying action you define, such as a first payment.

signupEvent.description: The signup tracking method. `FORM_DETECTION` = GrowSurf automatically detects submissions of an existing form on your site; `PROGRAMMATIC` = you add participants via the JavaScript/mobile SDKs or this API.

shareUrl.description: The landing page referred friends are taken to when they click a participant's referral link — usually your homepage or a marketing page. Required; must include an `http(s)://` scheme and contain no `#`, `#!`, or `??`.

useGrowSurfHostedLinks.description: When `true`, each participant's referral link becomes a GrowSurf-hosted link instead of a link to your own share URL, and clicks are routed by the visitor's device (Android to Google Play, iOS to your iOS attribution or App Store URL, desktop to your share URL). Mainly used by mobile apps. Applies to referral links everywhere they appear, including the SDKs, integrations, webhooks, the GrowSurf window, and participant exports.

allowedUrls.description: Extra domains, beyond your share URL, where the GrowSurf window and SDK are allowed to run — handy for testing on local or staging URLs. Adding an apex domain (e.g. `https://piedpiper.com`) also allows its subdomains. Known shared-platform root domains, such as `github.io`, do not grant access. Add your site's hostname, such as `https://piedpiper.github.io`, or a domain you own. Path-based shared hosts, such as `unbouncepages.com`, require a domain you own. Each entry must include an `http(s)://` scheme. Sending this array replaces the entire list.

mobile.description: Settings for the GrowSurf iOS and Android mobile SDKs.

instructionSelections.description: Choices shown in the Program Editor installation guide. Send only the choices to change.

CampaignInstallationInstructionSelection.description: Saved installation guide choices for this program.

platform.description: Platform shown in the first installation step.

mobileAttributionProvider.description: Mobile attribution provider selected for the installation guide.

stepProviders.description: Provider or method selected for each installation step. Affiliate and referral steps are available only on their matching program type.

CampaignInstallationStepProviders.description: Saved method choices for the installation steps.

siteKey.description: Public reCAPTCHA site key used by the signup form.

secretKey.description: The reCAPTCHA secret key. Write-only — never returned by GET.

blockedEmails.description: Blocked emails (wildcards allowed). Max 10000. Replaces the whole list.

allowedEmails.description: Allowed email addresses or patterns. Replaces the whole list.

allowedIps.description: Allowed IP addresses or patterns. Replaces the whole list.

blockBurnerEmails.description: Whether signups from burner or disposable email addresses are blocked.

blockDataCenterIps.description: Whether signups from known data-center IP addresses are blocked.

blockHighRiskReferrers.description: Whether referrals from participants marked as high fraud risk are blocked.

autoBlockHighRiskIps.description: Whether high-risk signup IP addresses are added to the blocked IP list automatically.

maxSignupsPerIp2Min.description: Maximum signups allowed from one IP address in a 2-minute window.

maxSignupsPerIp10Min.description: Maximum signups allowed from one IP address in a 10-minute window.

CampaignOptionsTaxDocumentation.description: Affiliate programs only. Your company's billing details (name, address, and VAT number) used on affiliate payout invoices and for VAT handling.

companyName.description: Legal or billing company name used on affiliate payout invoices.

vatNumber.description: Your company VAT number, when VAT collection applies.

addressLine1.description: First line of the company address used on affiliate payout invoices.

city.description: City for the company address used on affiliate payout invoices.

recipients.description: Email addresses that receive program notifications.

events.description: Per-event on/off toggles. The available events depend on the program type.

PARTICIPANT_REACHED_A_GOAL.description: Notify recipients when a participant unlocks a reward.

NEW_PARTICIPANT_ADDED_NON_REFERRED.description: Notify recipients when a participant joins without being referred.

NEW_PARTICIPANT_ADDED_REFERRED.description: Notify recipients when a participant joins through a referral link.

CAMPAIGN_ENDED.description: Notify recipients when the program ends.

WEEKLY_PERFORMANCE_REPORT.description: Send recipients the weekly performance report.

MONTHLY_PERFORMANCE_REPORT.description: Send recipients the monthly performance report.

NEW_COMMISSION_ADDED.description: Notify recipients when an affiliate earns a new commission.

COMMISSION_ADJUSTED.description: Notify recipients when an affiliate commission is adjusted.

NEW_PAYOUT_ISSUED.description: Notify recipients when an affiliate payout is issued.

AFFILIATE_BATCH_PAYOUT_COMPLETED.description: Notify recipients when an affiliate payout batch completes.

MONTHLY_PAYOUT_REMINDER.description: Send recipients the monthly affiliate payout reminder.

AFFILIATE_APPLICATIONS_PENDING_REVIEW.description: Affiliate programs only. Notify recipients when new affiliate applications are waiting for review. Digests are sent at most once every 24 hours.

CampaignOptions.description: A program's options (the dashboard Program Editor's Options tab). To see the full object with every field and its current value, `GET` this resource, then `PATCH` back only the fields you want to change. Some fields are program-type specific (see the per-field notes).

affiliateApplicationMode.description: Affiliate programs only. How public signups join the program. `OPEN_ENROLLMENT` enrolls signups directly (the default for programs created before applications existed). `MANUAL_REVIEW` collects an application you approve or deny. `AUTO_APPROVE` collects the full application and approves it immediately. Switching to a reviewed mode requires a saved Program Page. Trusted enrollment through the API, CSV import, dashboard, or invites is never blocked by this setting.

affiliateReapplicationPolicy.description: Affiliate programs only. Whether a denied applicant may apply again. `AFTER_COOLDOWN` (the default) allows a new application once `affiliateReapplicationCooldownDays` has passed; `DISABLED` never allows one.

affiliateReapplicationCooldownDays.description: Affiliate programs only. How many days a denied applicant waits before they can apply again (1-365, default 30). Only used when `affiliateReapplicationPolicy` is `AFTER_COOLDOWN`.

affiliateApplicationReviewEstimateBusine.description: Affiliate programs only. Optional review-time expectation (in business days, 1-60) shown to pending applicants. Send `null` to clear it; when unset, applicants see neutral "we'll email you" copy instead.

requireManualRewardApproval.description: Referral programs only. When `true`, each reward a participant earns is held for you to manually approve before it unlocks (and before the reward-won email is sent); when `false`, earned rewards are approved automatically. Cannot be `true` together with `autoFulfillRewards`.

autoFulfillRewards.description: Referral programs only. When `true`, rewards a participant earns are automatically marked as sent instead of you marking each one by hand, usually paired with an automated reward-delivery integration. Cannot be `true` together with `requireManualRewardApproval`.

requireManualFraudApproval.description: When `true`, no signup is automatically blocked for fraud. Every participant is allowed to join, and any suspected fraud is flagged in your dashboard for you to review. Cannot be `true` together with `autoBlockFraud`.

autoBlockFraud.description: When `true`, signups flagged as high fraud risk are automatically blocked from joining; when `false`, they are allowed in and flagged in your dashboard for review. Cannot be `true` together with `requireManualFraudApproval`.

requireParticipantAuth.description: Require returning participants to authenticate. Affiliate programs require this to be `true`.

enforceGdprCompliance.description: When `true`, GrowSurf stores only the minimum participant data needed to help you meet GDPR/CCPA requirements. Some participant fields are omitted and fraud screening is limited while this is on.

blockPaidAdsTraffic.description: When `true`, referrals from visitors who arrived through paid ads (for example Google or Facebook ads) are not attributed, so the referring participant is not credited for them. Recommended so participants don't compete with you for your own paid keywords.

attributionModel.description: Selects which server-verified visit receives conversion credit within `referralCookieWindowDays`. `LAST_CLICK` is used when this field is missing, including for programs created before attribution models were configurable.

referralCookieWindowDays.description: How long, in days, a referral-link click is remembered in the visitor's browser. If the visitor signs up within this window, the referral is credited to the participant whose link they clicked.

referralCreditWindowDays.description: How long, in days, a referred friend has to complete a qualifying action for their referrer to earn credit and unlock a reward. After this window the referral no longer counts toward rewards. `null` = never expires.

payoutThreshold.description: Affiliate programs only. Minimum payout in the program's currency minor units (`0` or `null` = no minimum). Requires `currencyISO` to be set.

fraud.description: Anti-fraud settings — block and allow lists for emails, IPs, and countries; toggles for blocking burner emails, data-center IPs, and referrals from high-risk referrers; per-IP signup rate limits; and reCAPTCHA.

taxDocumentation.description: Affiliate programs only. Your company's billing details (name, address, and VAT number) used on affiliate payout invoices and for VAT handling.

participantAvatarStyle.description: The participant avatar style. New programs start with `CHARACTERS`. Programs with a missing or unknown stored value return `INITIALS` for backward compatibility.

window.description: How the sections inside the GrowSurf window are laid out. `navigationMode` chooses between a tabbed layout (`TABS`) and a single scrolling list (`LIST`).

header.description: Header content for participants (`postText`) and non-participants (`preText`).

stats.description: The stats panel a participant sees at the top of the GrowSurf window, summarizing their own referral progress. Only its heading text (`title`) is editable here.

share.description: Share channels (`type.<channel>.{isVisible,buttonText,message,order}`), invite settings, and share-button styling.

signup.description: Signup form (`fields[]`, GDPR consent, button and login text).

login.description: Customizable text shown during participant sign-in.

payoutDestinationConfirmation.description: Customizable text for the participant-facing payout-destination confirmation page.

countryLabels.description: Participant-facing country-name overrides, keyed by ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (for example `GB`). Each label replaces the default country name wherever participants pick a country, such as payout and tax forms. Overrides merge per code, so send only the codes you want to change; send `null` (or the default name) for a code to restore its default. Unknown codes are rejected.

referralStatus.description: The Referral Status section, which lists the people a participant has invited and each one's progress (invite sent, pending, awarded, or expired). Controls its title, icon, column and status labels, empty-state text, and email masking. `revealInviteEmails` lets a signed-in participant see original invitation addresses when disclosure permission was recorded. Private invites and full email masking keep addresses hidden. Other referral addresses stay masked. `revealInviteEmailText` supplies the sign-in prompt; `followUp` supplies the invitation follow-up labels and messages.

leaderboard.description: The Leaderboard section that ranks participants against each other. Controls its title, icon, column labels, which time-period and ranking selectors appear, empty-state text, and how other participants' names are masked.

referredExperience.description: The banner, headline, and Claim Offer Popup shown to someone who arrives on your site through a referral link. Controls their copy and placement, whether the popup is enabled, and how the referrer's name is formatted. The popup is available for both referral and affiliate programs.

isOfferPopupEnabled.description: Whether referred visitors see the Claim Offer Popup. Affiliate programs start with it disabled until you opt in.

offerPopupTitle.description: Popup heading. Supports the same dynamic-text variables as the dashboard editor.

offerPopupDescription.description: Text shown below the popup heading.

offerPopupButtonText.description: Text on the button that saves the visitor's offer.

offerPopupImageUrl.description: Optional image shown in the popup.

isOfferPopupReferrerImageShown.description: Whether the popup shows the referrer's profile image when one is available.

offerPopupPlacement.description: Where the popup appears. Small screens may use a bottom sheet.

offerPopupDelaySeconds.description: Seconds to wait before showing the popup.

offerPopupThankYouText.description: Message shown after the visitor saves the offer.

offerPopupThankYouButtonText.description: Text on the post-claim button that opens the configured signup URL.

isOfferPopupConfettiEnabled.description: Whether to show confetti after the visitor saves the offer.

isOfferPopupShownOnAllPages.description: Whether the popup can appear on every page where GrowSurf is installed instead of only the Share URL.

offerPopupSecondaryLinkText.description: Optional secondary-link text shown after the offer is saved.

offerPopupSecondaryLinkUrl.description: Destination for the optional secondary link. Must start with `http://` or `https://`. Send `null` or an empty string to clear it.

isOfferPopupOverlayDimmed.description: Whether the centered popup dims the page behind it.

offerPopupEmailPlaceholder.description: Hint text inside the popup's email field. Leave it empty to reuse the email field label from your signup form.

offerPopupPromoCodeCopyLabel.description: Text on the copy action beside the promo code, shown after the offer is claimed when an upfront-discount coupon is enabled.

offerPopupSubmitError.description: Message shown inside the popup when the offer cannot be saved, such as during a connection problem.

isBannerEnabled.description: Whether referred visitors see the welcome banner, a sticky banner that follows them as they scroll your Share URL.

bannerText.description: Welcome banner copy. Accepts HTML and the same dynamic-text variables as the dashboard editor.

bannerPlacement.description: Where the welcome banner sits on the page.

isBannerClickableToSignupUrl.description: Whether clicking the welcome banner opens the program's signup URL. It has no effect until a signup URL is configured.

isHeadingEnabled.description: Whether referred visitors see the inline welcome message added to the main heading on your Share URL.

headingText.description: Inline welcome message copy. Accepts HTML and the same dynamic-text variables as the dashboard editor.

headingTarget.description: Which heading element on the page the inline welcome message attaches to. GrowSurf uses the first match.

headingPlacement.description: Whether the inline welcome message goes before the target heading, after it, or replaces it.

isHeadingStyled.description: Whether the inline welcome message keeps its own styling. When `false` it renders as plain text.

isHeadingClickableToSignupUrl.description: Whether clicking the inline welcome message opens the program's signup URL. It has no effect until a signup URL is configured.

pageTitleReplacement.description: Browser tab title shown to referred visitors on your Share URL, in place of the page's own title.

referrerNameFormat.description: How the referrer's name appears in referred-visitor copy — `FIRST` (`Gavin`), `FIRST_LAST_INITIAL` (`Gavin B`), or `FIRST_LAST` (`Gavin Belson`).

referrerNameFallback.description: Name used in referred-visitor copy when the referrer has no first or last name on file.

widget.description: The website widget — the invite that sits in a corner of your own site. It renders as a button or as a card, and its card folds back into the button when a visitor closes it. Both audience switches start off, so a program shows nothing until you turn one on.

isShownToNewVisitors.description: Whether people who have not joined your program see the widget.

isShownToParticipants.description: Whether people who have already joined see the widget.

appearance.description: `BUTTON` is a single button in the corner. `CARD` is a small card with a heading, a line of text, and a button, which a visitor can close.

isArtShown.description: Whether the card shows a picture above its text. Ignored by the button.

artImageUrl.description: The picture shown at the top of the card.

newVisitorText.description: What people who have not joined read. It is the button's label, and the card's heading.

participantText.description: What people who have already joined read. It is the button's label, and the card's heading.

newVisitorDescription.description: The line under the heading for people who have not joined. Card only.

participantDescription.description: The line under the heading for people who have already joined. Card only.

buttonText.description: The label on the card's button, which opens your program.

markKey.description: The small drawing on the widget. It takes the color you chose for the widget, so it matches on any background. Send `null` for no drawing.

icon.description: Your own uploaded image instead of a `markKey` drawing. `CUSTOM` uses `iconImageUrl`; `NONE` shows no image. `DEFAULT` is the old GrowSurf image: a program already set to it keeps it and can read it back, but it cannot be set. Requires a paid plan.

iconImageUrl.description: Your own image, used when `icon` is `CUSTOM`. Requires a paid plan.

placement.description: Which corner or edge of the page the widget sits against.

offsetSide.description: How far in from the left or right edge, in pixels, following `placement`. For a centered placement it becomes an even gap on both sides.

offsetEdge.description: How far in from the top or bottom edge, in pixels, following `placement`. Raise it to clear a chat button that already sits in that corner.

reveal.description: What the element waits for before it appears: the page loading (`IMMEDIATE`) or the visitor scrolling halfway down the page (`SCROLL`). `revealDelaySeconds` then counts from that moment. `DELAY` is accepted for older programs and behaves as `IMMEDIATE`.

revealDelaySeconds.description: Seconds to wait after the `reveal` trigger before showing the element. `0` shows it the moment the trigger fires.

returnAfterDays.description: Days before the card is offered again to someone who closed it. Until then they keep the button, so they can still open your program. `0` never offers it again.

isHiddenOnMobile.description: Whether to leave phones alone. On small screens the card fills the bottom of the page, so some programs turn it off there.

pageRules.description: Which pages the widget appears on. This controls the widget only — referral tracking, embedded elements, and opening the window from your own code keep working on every page where GrowSurf is installed.

mode.description: `ALL` shows it everywhere. `ONLY` shows it just on the listed pages. `EXCEPT` shows it everywhere but the listed pages. With no pages listed, `ONLY` and `EXCEPT` behave as `ALL`.

patterns.description: The pages to match. Use `*` to stand in for anything, as in `/portal/*`. A path on its own, such as `/pricing`, matches that path on every domain you have installed. Web addresses are matched without their query string.

trafficInsights.description: The Traffic report participants can open from the GrowSurf window. It shows visits to their share link over time and where those visits came from. It starts on for new affiliate programs and hidden for referral programs. `GET` returns every setting, with the default copy for anything you have not changed. `PATCH` only the settings you want to change; the rest keep their current values. Labels cannot be blank.

isPublicDisplayed.description: Whether participants can open the Traffic report.

trafficForLabel.description: The label in front of the share link picker.

allLinksLabel.description: The share link picker option that combines all of the participant's links.

visitsOverTimeTitle.description: The heading above the visits chart.

breakdownsTitle.description: The heading above the breakdown table.

viewTrafficInsightsLinkText.description: The text of the row or tab that opens the report.

backLinkText.description: The text of the link back from the report.

emptyState.description: The message shown before the participant's link has any visits. Can be empty.

notSetLabel.description: The row name for visits that have no value for the chosen breakdown, such as a visit without `utm_source`.

messages.description: Messages shown when the report cannot show everything.

error.description: Shown when the report fails to load.

unavailable.description: Shown when there is no traffic history for the chosen period.

partial.description: Shown when only part of the chosen period is available.

partialFrom.description: Like `partial`, with the first available date. `{{date}}` is replaced with that date.

breakdownPartial.description: Shown when some breakdown rows may be missing.

breakdownEmpty.description: Shown when the chosen breakdown has no rows.

dateRangeLabels.description: The date range picker labels, keyed by `LAST_7_DAYS`, `LAST_30_DAYS`, `LAST_90_DAYS`, and `ALL_TIME`.

defaultDateRange.description: The date range the report opens with.

metrics.description: The two visit counts at the top of the report.

visits.description: Every time someone opened the participant's link.

uniqueVisitors.description: People who opened the participant's link, counted once each.

breakdowns.description: The tables that show where visits came from. You can hide or rename each one.

referrer.description: Visits by the site that linked to the participant's link.

destination.description: Visits by the page the link opened.

technology.description: Visits by device, browser, and operating system.

trigger.description: Visits by how the visitor arrived, such as a page visit or a QR code.

referralSummary.description: Referral programs only. The row of summary tiles a participant sees (clicks, leads, referrals, invites sent, rewards earned, and more). Controls each tile's label, tooltip, and visibility, plus the section's title and icon.

affiliateSummary.description: Affiliate programs only. The row of summary tiles an affiliate sees (clicks, leads, referrals, referral revenue, upcoming payout, and total paid out). Controls each tile's label, tooltip, and visibility, plus the section's title and icon.

commissions.description: Affiliate programs only. The Commissions section of the participant portal, which lists an affiliate's earned commissions and their status (pending, approved, paid, or reversed). Controls its title, icon, column labels, status labels and tooltips, and empty-state text.

payouts.description: Affiliate programs only. The Payouts section of the participant portal, which lists an affiliate's payouts and their status (upcoming, queued, issued, failed, or reversed). Controls its title, icon, column labels, status labels and tooltips, and empty-state text.

rewards.description: The heading, icon, and empty-state text of the rewards panel shown to participants. Which rewards appear, and the order they appear in, are managed through the campaign rewards endpoints, not here.

resources.description: Participant presentation settings for Resources. Resource content and publication order are managed through the program Resources endpoints.

isPublicDisplayed.description: Whether the Resources destination is enabled. It remains hidden until at least one valid resource is published.

emptyState.description: Text shown in place of the list when no resources are published.

icon.description: Icon configuration for the Resources destination.

type.description: Whether to use the default icon, a configured image, or no icon.

imageUrl.description: LIST-mode icon image URL when `type` is `IMAGE`.

participantSettings.description: The participant's account settings area in the portal. Controls the labels and messages for logging out, managing PayPal and Wise payout emails (including confirmation, connected, expired, and repair states), and completing tax details (country of residency, VAT, and tax-form status). Wise payout copy applies to affiliate programs; the other fields also apply to eligible referral programs.

landingPages.description: Portal and landing pages — company info, `content` (FAQ/terms/labels), `styles` (fonts), third-party script IDs (GA/GTM/Facebook/HubSpot), and SEO meta tags. Custom code, CSS, and JS are not editable via the API.

theme.description: Visual theme styling (colors, shadows, and similar).

widget.description: Paid-plan color settings for the website widget.

color.description: Text and drawing color on the button, and on the card's own button.

backgroundColor.description: Fill color of the button, and of the card's own button.

borderRadius.description: Corner rounding, as a CSS length such as `12px`.

referredExperienceOfferPopup.description: Paid-plan color settings for the Claim Offer Popup.

CampaignDesignTrafficInsightsMetric.description: One visit count at the top of the Traffic report.

helperText.description: A short explanation under the name. Send an empty string to hide it.

CampaignDesignTrafficInsightsBreakdown.description: One breakdown table in the Traffic report.

isVisible.description: Whether participants can choose this breakdown.

label.description: The breakdown's name in the picker.

levels.description: Names for the levels this breakdown can be read at. `utm` has `source`, `medium`, `campaign`, `term`, `content`, `id`, `sourcePlatform`, `creativeFormat`, and `marketingTactic`. `geo` has `country`, `region`, `city`, and `continent`. `technology` has `device`, `browser`, and `os`. Other breakdowns have no levels.

values.description: Names for rows from a fixed set. `referrer` has `DIRECT`. `technology` has `DESKTOP`, `MOBILE`, and `TABLET`. `trigger` has `PAGE_ENTRY`, `QR_CODE`, `DEEP_LINK`, `DEFERRED_DEEP_LINK`, `INSTALL_REFERRER`, and `MANUAL`. Other breakdowns have no fixed rows.

ProgramResourceModerationStatus.description: The latest security review state for an access-controlled FILE. `PENDING` and `APPROVED` files can be published and downloaded; a `REJECTED` file is blocked everywhere, including one that was already published.

fileName.description: Original file name shown to program managers and participants.

mimeType.description: MIME type detected from the uploaded bytes.

moderationStatus.description: Security review state for the access-controlled file.

ProgramResource.description: One ordered program Resource. File delivery coordinates and internal database identifiers are never returned.

category.description: Optional category heading. Resources keep their explicit order across headings.

url.description: HTTPS destination for a LINK; otherwise `null`.

text.description: Plain copyable content for TEXT; otherwise `null`.

isPublished.description: Whether eligible participants can receive the resource.

createdAt.description: Unix time in milliseconds when the resource was created.

updatedAt.description: Unix time in milliseconds when the resource was last updated.

resources.description: Ordered resources visible to the caller.

isPublished.description: Whether eligible participants can receive the resource.

ProgramResourceUploadResult.description: The unmodified signed result returned after uploading with a GrowSurf ticket.

asset_id.description: Asset identifier returned by the signed upload.

public_id.description: Public upload identifier that must match the upload ticket.

version.description: Asset version included in upload-response signature verification.

signature.description: Signature used to verify the upload result.

resource_type.description: Upload resource type selected for the file format.

type.description: Access-controlled delivery type required for resource files.

bytes.description: File size reported by the upload in bytes.

secure_url.description: URL used only for server-side upload verification.

format.description: File format reported by the upload.

url.description: HTTPS destination required for a LINK resource.

type.description: New resource content type when changing the type.

isPublished.description: Whether eligible participants can receive the resource.

position.description: New zero-based display position. It must be less than the current Resource count; the list remains dense.

url.description: HTTPS destination for a LINK resource.

text.description: Plain copyable content for a TEXT resource.

uploadTicket.description: One-time ticket required when replacing FILE content.
