success.description: Confirms that the resource was deleted.

fileName.description: File name with an allowed extension.

mimeType.description: Browser-declared MIME type. GrowSurf also verifies the file signature after upload.

ticket.description: One-time bearer-like ticket. Do not log or persist it.

uploadUrl.description: Endpoint that accepts the signed direct upload.

uploadParameters.description: Opaque signed scalar fields that must be sent unchanged with the file upload.

CampaignRewardListResponse.description: The list of a program's configured rewards.

rewards.description: The program's configured Campaign Rewards, including switched-off rewards. Deleted rewards are excluded. A reward can be earned only when it also appears in the campaign response's embedded `rewards` array.

RewardWritableFields.description: The writable fields shared by the create and update campaign reward requests.

title.description: The reward title (internal only, never exposed to participants).

description.description: The reward description shown to the referrer.

referralDescription.description: The reward description shown to the referred friend (double-sided rewards only).

imageUrl.description: An image URL for the reward.

isVisible.description: Whether the reward is enabled. When `false`, the reward is disabled: it is no longer awarded, and it is hidden from participants, including those who already earned it. Set `true` for the reward to be visible and awardable.

isUnlimited.description: Whether the reward can be earned an unlimited number of times. Defaults to `true`, except `MILESTONE` rewards, which can only be earned once.

referredRewardUpfront.description: For double-sided rewards, deliver the referred friend's reward upfront as a discount.

event.description: The event that earns a SINGLE_SIDED, DOUBLE_SIDED, or MILESTONE referral reward. Defaults to CONVERSION. LEAD requires the program's referralTrigger to be CUSTOM.

limit.description: The number of times a participant can earn the reward (overridden by `isUnlimited`).

conversionsRequired.description: The number of referrals required to earn the reward.

numberOfWinners.description: The maximum number of winners. Only applies to `LEADERBOARD` rewards. When `limitDuration` is `PER_MONTH`, this many top referrers win each month; otherwise this many win in total. A `LEADERBOARD` reward that omits it defaults to `3`.

order.description: The display order of the reward.

nextMilestonePrefix.description: Text shown before a participant's referral count in milestone progress copy (e.g. `You are only`). Applies to `MILESTONE` rewards.

nextMilestoneSuffix.description: Text shown after a participant's referral count in milestone progress copy (e.g. `referrals away from your next reward!`). Applies to `MILESTONE` rewards.

couponCode.description: A legacy static coupon code shown to the referrer in the reward-won email and webhook when this reward is earned. Display text only; GrowSurf does not create or validate it in any billing system. If the program has a connected billing integration (Stripe, Chargebee, or Recurly) that issues a coupon for the referral, that issued code is shown instead.

referralCouponCode.description: A legacy static coupon code shown to the referred friend in the reward-won email and webhook (double-sided rewards). Same behavior and caveats as `couponCode`: display text only, not created or validated in any billing system, and superseded by a connected billing integration's issued coupon when one exists.

metadata.description: Custom key/value metadata (single-level; keys are camelCased on save; values are stored as strings). Sending `metadata` REPLACES the stored object. Campaign copy can reference a key via `{{campaignReward['<rewardId>']['<key>']}}` tokens: renaming a key (same value, new key) automatically rewrites those references; removing a key that campaign copy still references returns a `409` listing the referencing fields.

commissionStructure.description: The affiliate commission structure (AFFILIATE rewards only). REQUIRED when creating an AFFILIATE reward — include `amount` (and optionally `amountISO`) for a `FIXED` commission, or `percent` for a `PERCENT` commission.

value.description: Tax valuation for the reward (the referrer's side of a double-sided reward). Used by tax documentation / 1099 reporting. `null` when no valuation is set. Commission rewards always use their actual cash amount and the `NONEMPLOYEE_SERVICES` tax character, so GrowSurf clears these settings for that reward type.

referredValue.description: Tax valuation for the referred friend's side of a double-sided reward. Set its treatment independently when the two sides are earned for different reasons. `null` when no valuation is set. Commission rewards have no referred-friend side, so GrowSurf clears these settings for that reward type.

RewardTaxValuation.description: Tax valuation settings for a reward. Only relevant when the program collects tax documentation.

fairMarketValueUSD.description: Manual fair-market value in USD (major units) used as the fallback when the reward value cannot be resolved automatically. `null` = no manual value.

taxCharacter.description: The reason the recipient earns this reward. `null` inherits the program's confirmed tax treatment for configurable non-commission rewards. Commission rewards always use `NONEMPLOYEE_SERVICES`.

RewardCreateRequest.description: Request body for creating a campaign reward. `type` is required and must be compatible with the program type. AFFILIATE rewards additionally require `commissionStructure` (with `amount` for a `FIXED` commission or `percent` for a `PERCENT` commission).

type.description: The reward type. Immutable after creation.

RewardUpdateRequest.description: Request body for updating a campaign reward. All fields are optional; `type` is immutable and must not be supplied.

success.description: Whether the campaign reward was deleted.

Reward.description: A single campaign reward (also known as a `CampaignReward`). This is different from a `ParticipantReward`, which is a reward earned by a participant.

id.description: The unique identifier of the campaign reward. You can find this ID from *Program Editor > 1. Rewards* and clicking the reward.

event.description: The event that earns this referral reward. Present for SINGLE_SIDED, DOUBLE_SIDED, and MILESTONE rewards. Legacy rewards return CONVERSION.

title.description: The reward title (internal only, never exposed to participants).

isVisible.description: Whether the reward is enabled. When `false`, the reward is disabled: it is no longer awarded, and it is hidden from participants, including those who already earned it. Set `true` for the reward to be visible and awardable.

description.description: The reward description shown to the referrer.
description.example: Refer a friend and get a Pied Piper T-Shirt

referralDescription.description: The reward description shown to the referred friend (only applicable for double-sided reward types).
referralDescription.example: Join and receive middle out compression algorithm

referredRewardUpfront.description: Only applies to double-sided rewards. When `true`, the referred friend's reward is delivered upfront as a discount and no `ParticipantReward` is created for them when the referral triggers.

isUnlimited.description: `true` if this reward can be earned by a single participant an unlimited number of times.

limit.description: The number of times a participant can earn this reward (overridden when `isUnlimited` is `true`). `-1` represents an unlimited reward in REST responses.

conversionsRequired.description: The number of referrals a participant must make to earn this reward.

numberOfWinners.description: The maximum number of winners. Only applies to `LEADERBOARD` rewards. When `limitDuration` is `PER_MONTH`, this many top referrers win each month; otherwise this many win in total.

limitDuration.description: Whether the reward can be earned in total, on a monthly basis, or on a yearly basis.

couponCode.description: A legacy static coupon code shown to the referrer in the reward-won email and webhook. Display text only; GrowSurf does not create or validate it in any billing system. If the program has a connected billing integration (Stripe, Chargebee, or Recurly) that issues a coupon for the referral, that issued code is shown instead.

order.description: If there are multiple rewards, the order in which the reward should be displayed. `null` by default until set within the Design step of the program editor.

nextMilestonePrefix.description: Text displayed in front of a participant's referral count for UI purposes (e.g., "You are only"). Applicable for milestone rewards (when `type` is `MILESTONE`).

nextMilestoneSuffix.description: Text displayed after a participant's referral count for UI purposes (e.g., "referrals away from receiving a nice reward!"). Applicable for milestone rewards (when `type` is `MILESTONE`).
nextMilestoneSuffix.example: referrals away from receiving a nice reward!

commissionStructure.description: The reward commission structure. Present only for affiliate programs.

referralCouponCode.description: A legacy static coupon code shown to the referred friend in the reward-won email and webhook (double-sided rewards). Same caveats as `couponCode`: display text only, not created or validated in any billing system, and superseded by a connected billing integration's issued coupon when one exists.

value.description: Tax valuation for the reward (the referrer's side of a double-sided reward). `null` when no valuation is set. For commission rewards, both fields are `null`; GrowSurf classifies the actual commission amount as `NONEMPLOYEE_SERVICES`.

referredValue.description: Tax valuation for the referred friend's side of a double-sided reward. `null` when no valuation is set. Commission rewards have no referred-friend side, so both fields are `null`.

CommissionStructure.description: The commission configuration for an affiliate reward. Present only for affiliate programs.

amount.description: Fixed commission amount in the currency's smallest denomination, used when `type` is `FIXED`. `null` for percentage-based commissions.

amountISO.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the fixed `amount`. Defaults to the program's currency when omitted. Must match the campaign `currencyISO` when provided. `null` for percentage-based commissions.

event.description: The event that generates a commission. Missing legacy values read as `SALE`.

type.description: How the commission is calculated: `PERCENT` (a percentage of the sale) or `FIXED` (a fixed `amount`).

minPaidReferrals.description: The minimum number of paid referrals required before commissions are earned.

holdDuration.description: Number of days a commission is held before it can be paid out.

duration.description: How long commissions continue to be earned for a referred customer: `FOREVER`, `REPEATING`, or `ONCE`. Only applies when `event` is `SALE`. `null` for `CLICK` and `LEAD` commissions, which pay once per event.

durationInMonths.description: When `duration` is `REPEATING`, the number of months over which commissions are earned. `null` otherwise.

approvalRequired.description: `true` if commissions require manual approval before they can be paid out.

percent.description: The commission percentage, used when `type` is `PERCENT`.

hasMaxAmount.description: `true` if a maximum commission amount cap is configured.

maxAmount.description: The maximum commission amount cap in the currency's smallest denomination. `null` if no cap is set.

maxAmountISO.description: The [ISO 4217](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html) currency code for `maxAmount`. Must match the campaign `currencyISO` when provided.

hasIntro.description: `true` if an introductory commission rate is configured. Only applies when `event` is `SALE`. Always `false` for `CLICK` and `LEAD` commissions, whose `intro*` fields are `null`.

introType.description: How the introductory commission is calculated: `PERCENT` or `FIXED`.

introPercent.description: The introductory commission percentage, used when `introType` is `PERCENT`.

introAmount.description: The introductory commission amount in the currency's smallest denomination, used when `introType` is `FIXED`.

introAmountISO.description: The [ISO 4217](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html) currency code for `introAmount`. Must match the campaign `currencyISO` when provided.

introDuration.description: How long the introductory rate applies.

introDurationInMonths.description: When `introDuration` is repeating, the number of months the introductory rate applies.

Participant.description: Detailed information about a program participant.

id.description: The unique identifier of the participant.

isAffiliate.description: Affiliate programs only. Whether this participant is an enrolled affiliate. A referred customer who has not joined the program is `false`.

affiliateStatus.description: Affiliate programs only. The enrolled affiliate's status (`APPROVED`, `SUSPENDED`, or `BANNED`). `null` for participants who are not affiliates.

affiliateEnrollmentSource.description: Affiliate programs only. How the affiliate enrolled (`OPEN_ENROLLMENT`, `APPLICATION`, `PARTICIPANT_AUTH`, `INVITE`, `REST_API`, `CSV`, or `DASHBOARD`). `null` when not recorded.

firstName.description: The first name of the participant.

lastName.description: The last name of the participant.

paypalEmailAddress.description: The PayPal email address on file for the participant, used for affiliate or PayPal reward payouts.

referralCount.description: The total number of referrals made by the participant.

monthlyReferralCount.description: The total number of referrals made this month by the participant (resets at the end of the month).

prevMonthlyReferralCount.description: The total number of referrals made the previous month by the participant.

leadCount.description: The number of pending referrals the participant made that have not converted into successful referrals yet. Not cumulative: it goes down when a lead converts.

monthlyRank.description: The monthly rank of the participant. This rank resets to 0 at the end of each month.

prevMonthlyRank.description: The previous monthly rank of the participant. Not returned if the participant did not exist in your program during the previous month.

shareUrl.description:
The unique share URL of the participant. Omitted for affiliate program
participants who are not approved affiliates.

createdAt.description: The date the participant was added to the program (UTC milliseconds).

referralSource.description: The source of how the participant joined the program.

referralStatus.description: If the participant was referred, the referrer's status in receiving the referral credit. Only applicable if the participant was referred into the program.

referredBy.description: The ID of the referrer. Only applicable if the participant was referred into the program.

fraudRiskLevel.description: A value that represents the integrity of the participant.

fraudReasonCode.description:
Machine-readable label for the participant's `fraudRiskLevel`. The label identifies broad
outcomes such as unique or duplicate participant data, suspicious referral activity,
configured access rules, or a manual update.

Current labels include `UNIQUE_IDENTITY`, `DUPLICATE_EMAIL`, `DUPLICATE_IDENTITY`,
`DUPLICATE_IDENTITY_EXCESSIVE`, `EMAIL_FRAUD`, `SIMILAR_EMAIL`, `SIMILAR_FIRST_NAME`,
`SIMILAR_LAST_NAME`, `REFERRAL_EMAIL_PATTERN`, `REFERRAL_CHAIN_FRAUD`,
`REFERRAL_VELOCITY_FRAUD`, `DOMAIN_CLUSTERING_FRAUD`, `MANUAL_UPDATE`, `WHITELISTED`,
`BLACKLIST_MATCH`, `BLOCKED_IP`, and `REFERRER_HIGH_RISK`. Treat this as a diagnostic
label because GrowSurf can add labels without notice.

isWinner.description: `true` if the participant has earned one or more rewards.

shareCount.description: An object containing counts of how many times the participant has shared their referral link, keyed by channel. Standard web channels include `email`, `facebook`, and `twitter`; SDK/native-share channels include `iosNativeShare` and `androidNativeShare`.

impressionCount.description: The total number of impressions the participant has made.

uniqueImpressionCount.description: The total number of unique impressions the participant has made.

inviteCount.description: The total number of invites the participant has sent.

referrals.description: A list of `Participant` IDs who were successfully referred by the participant. Limited to the 100 most recently referred friends.

monthlyReferrals.description: A list of `Participant` IDs successfully referred by the participant this month (resets at the end of the month). Limited to the 100 most recent.

referrer.description: An object containing the participant's referrer information. Only applicable if the participant was referred into the program.

ipAddress.description: The IP address recorded for the participant, or `null` when unavailable.

fingerprint.description: The browser identifier recorded for the participant, or `null` when unavailable.

mobileInstanceId.description: App-install scoped identifier supplied by a native app, or `null` when unavailable. The official mobile SDKs generate a lowercase UUID. Not stored when strict GDPR/CCPA mode is enabled.

metadata.description: An object containing any custom key-value data, useful for saving additional data for the participant (e.g., `company`, `companySize`). Metadata is never used by GrowSurf and usage is optional. Metadata is returned only in REST API calls, and never in JavaScript Web API calls. See [API Guidelines](https://docs.growsurf.com/developer-tools/rest-api/api-guidelines).

notes.description: Internal notes about the participant, added via the [GrowSurf Dashboard](https://growsurf.com/dashboard).
notes.example: This is obviously our competitor trying out our product!

unsubscribed.description: `true` if the participant has unsubscribed from program emails.

rewards.description: A list of the rewards the participant has earned.

vanityKeys.description: The list of vanity keys that the participant has.

unreadCommissionsCount.description: Affiliate programs only. The number of commissions the participant has not yet viewed.

unreadPayoutsCount.description: Affiliate programs only. The number of payouts the participant has not yet viewed.

isNew.description: Whether this participant was newly created by the request. Returned by participant creation calls; `false` when the participant already existed.

allMatchingFraudsters.description: A list of other participant IDs associated with this participant's fraud status.

payoutSettings.description: Payout-related actions the participant must complete before a payout can be released (e.g. configuring a payout destination or submitting a W-9/W-8 tax form). Always present; the requiredActions array is empty when no action is required.

requiredActions.description: Actions the participant must complete before payouts can be sent.

ParticipantReferrer.description: Summary information about a participant's referrer, returned within the `referrer` field of a `Participant`.

id.description: The unique identifier of the referrer.

firstName.description: The first name of the referrer.

lastName.description: The last name of the referrer.

referralCount.description: The total number of referrals made by the referrer.

monthlyReferralCount.description: The total number of referrals made this month by the referrer (resets at the end of the month).

prevMonthlyReferralCount.description: The total number of referrals made the previous month by the referrer.

leadCount.description: The number of pending referrals the referrer made that have not converted into successful referrals yet.

monthlyRank.description: The monthly rank of the referrer. This rank resets to 0 at the end of each month.

prevMonthlyRank.description: The previous monthly rank of the referrer.

shareUrl.description: The unique share URL of the referrer.

createdAt.description: The date the referrer was added to the program (UTC milliseconds).

referralSource.description: The source of how the referrer joined the program.

referralStatus.description: If the referrer was themselves referred, their referrer's status in receiving the referral credit.

fraudRiskLevel.description: A value that represents the integrity of the referrer.

fraudReasonCode.description: The reason for the referrer's `fraudRiskLevel`. See `Participant.fraudReasonCode` for the list of possible values.

isWinner.description: `true` if the referrer has earned one or more rewards.

shareCount.description: An object containing counts of how many times the referrer has shared their referral link, keyed by channel.

impressionCount.description: The total number of impressions the referrer has made.

uniqueImpressionCount.description: The total number of unique impressions the referrer has made.

inviteCount.description: The total number of invites the referrer has sent.

referrals.description: A list of `Participant` IDs who were successfully referred by the referrer. Limited to the 100 most recent.

monthlyReferrals.description: A list of `Participant` IDs successfully referred by the referrer this month (resets at the end of the month). Limited to the 100 most recent.

ipAddress.description: The IP address recorded for the referrer, or `null` when unavailable.

fingerprint.description: The browser identifier recorded for the referrer, or `null` when unavailable.

metadata.description: An object containing any custom key-value data for the referrer.

unsubscribed.description: `true` if the referrer has unsubscribed from program emails.

ParticipantReward.description: A reward that a participant has earned. This is different from a program `Reward` Object and contains information pertinent only to the participant that earned the reward.

id.description: The unique identifier of the participant's reward. This is different for every new reward the participant earns.

rewardId.description: The ID of the program `Reward` (`CampaignReward`) that this participant has earned.

status.description: The status of the participant's reward.

unread.description: `true` if the participant has not yet seen the reward in a GrowSurf window.

approved.description: `true` if the participant's reward has been approved.

approvedAt.description: The date and time the reward was approved for this participant (UTC milliseconds). `null` for unapproved rewards.

fulfilledAt.description: The date and time the reward was marked as sent for this participant (UTC milliseconds). `null` if it has not been marked as sent.

isReferrer.description: `true` if the participant earned the reward as the referrer; `false` if they earned it as the referred friend (only applicable for double-sided reward types).

isAvailable.description: `true` if the reward is available for the participant to claim or redeem.

isFulfilled.description: `true` if the participant's reward has been marked as sent.

referredId.description: The ID of the friend that was referred.

For Stripe, use a Charge ID (`ch_...`) or PaymentIntent ID (`pi_...`); both identify the same captured payment. RefundTransactionRequest.description: To amend a Stripe, Chargebee or Recurly payment, supply `paymentProvider`, `testMode`, and the original provider payment's `transactionId` (a Charge or PaymentIntent ID for Stripe). These values must identify the same connected account and mode used for the sale. This records an amendment in GrowSurf; it does not send a refund through the payment provider. Omit `paymentProvider` and `testMode` for other transactions recorded through the API or dashboard. At least one transaction identifier is required. Use the same identifier you supplied when recording the sale.

paymentProvider.description: Connected payment provider for the original sale. Requires `transactionId` and `testMode`.

testMode.description: `true` for the original payment's test account or `false` for its live account. Required when `paymentProvider` is supplied; otherwise omit this field.

amendmentType.description: REFUND covers full refunds, partial refunds, and refund cancellations; CHARGEBACK is always a full reversal.

amountRefunded.description: Cumulative amount refunded so far, in the currency's minor unit. Omit for a full refund. For a partial refund send the running total, not the per-refund delta.

amount.description: Original sale gross (minor units). Optional — the value stored when the transaction was recorded is used when available; only needed for partial refunds of older records.

refundId.description: Stable per-refund identifier. Required when canceling a refund or changing the refunded total after a cancellation. Reuse the original refund's identifier for its cancellation. An amendment without enough refund identity returns `409` without applying the cancellation. Newly observed higher cumulative refunds and incomplete coverage are retained for reconciliation.

refundStatus.description: Refund status. Send `canceled` with the original `refundId` to cancel that refund. Record each original refund with `refundId` and `refundAmount` first. Missing or conflicting refund history returns `409` without applying the cancellation. Newly observed higher cumulative refunds and incomplete coverage are retained for reconciliation.

refundAmount.description: Positive amount for this individual refund, no greater than the sale amount, in the sale currency's minor unit. Send it with `refundId` on each original refund to support cancellations and out-of-order amendments. The amount for a given `refundId` cannot change. A cancellation can omit it when the original amount is already recorded. Incomplete refund history returns `409` without applying the cancellation. Newly observed higher cumulative refunds and incomplete coverage are retained for reconciliation.

refundHistoryComplete.description: Set `true` only after reconciling and recording every original refund's `refundId` and `refundAmount`, including refunds later canceled. This confirmation resolves previously incomplete refund history. Omit it during ordinary delivery. Cancellations remain `409` while history is incomplete. Replaying an old confirmation cannot reconcile a later gap; confirm a newly reconciled refund or complete provider list.
